purpose: Teach: 久保/浩/茂/竹内/後藤/従い/プロトコル/函

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 久保部長、引き継ぎ完了したらしい。
lines.en: Director Kubo's completed the handover, apparently.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, clipped delivery. Efficient, no padding. Eyes forward. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with quiet focus.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。浩さんが、後任で正式着任です。
lines.style: Clear confirmation, steady. Professional courtesy in the formality. No elaboration—this is accomplished fact. Straightforward eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 技術勉強会、茂さん、竹内さん、後藤さん、参加でしょ。
lines.en: Tech study group—Shigeru, Takeuchi, Goto are all coming, yeah?
lines.style: Rapid-fire, checking three names in quick sequence. Slightly rising inflection on the final 'yeah'—seeking confirmation. Practical, efficient pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 新しい指針に従い、プロトコル統一を進めます。
lines.en: We'll move forward with protocol alignment following the new guidelines.
lines.style: Measured, procedural tone. Each phrase lands with equal weight. No rush. The voice of someone explaining what comes next with quiet authority and no doubt.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: Hakodate branch is synced in on this too.
lines.style: Casual confirmation, slightly lower volume. A quick nod in the voice. No emphasis—just rounding out the full picture. Brief trailing-off.
